results.title: ANFA suspension lifted after months of restrictions
results.content: The National Sports Council reverses its action against the football governing body as Nepal seeks to address concerns raised by international football authorities.

results.title: Three killed, seven injured in jeep crash in Makawanpur
results.content: The passenger vehicle veered off the Hetauda-Bhaise road and plunged into a stream early Thursday while travelling from Rautahat to Kathmandu.

results.title: Chief removal controversies leave Nepal Police leadership shaky
results.content: Political interference, legal battles, factional rivalries and frequent changes to service rules have weakened the chain of command, undermined morale and obstructed institutional reform since the restoration of democracy in 1990.

results.title: Who gets to participate in Nepal’s creative industries?
results.content: At a Kathmandu forum, artists and advocates highlight barriers to representation, accessibility and participation in Nepal’s creative industries.

results.title: UML prepares local polls strategy, protest plans
results.content: Addressing over 3,400 cadres in Kathmandu, party chief KP Oli warns of possible government reprisals and urges cadres to prepare for protests.

results.title: Chitwan Rhinos knock Kathmandu Gorkhas out and progress to Qualifier 2
results.content: Chitwan defeated Kathmandu by 61 runs and entered Qualifier 2, where Sudurpaschim Royals are waiting. Chitwan and Sudurpaschim will vie for a spot in the final on Thursday.

results.title: Mishara’s record century sends Chitwan into Qualifier 2
results.content: Chitwan Rhinos beat Kathmandu Gorkhas by 61 runs in the Eliminator after Kamil Mishara smashed an unbeaten 120, the highest individual score in Nepal Premier League history.

results.title: Nepal, India to unveil 10-point vision for partnership during PM’s visit
results.content: The document, based on ‘Samriddha Nepal, Samunnat Bharat’, aims to translate bilateral commitments into measurable outcomes.

results.title: Police is my friend?
results.content: The slogan hangs on police walls across Nepal. A democracy should measure it by one simple test: what happens to a citizen who asks, “Under what law?”

results.title: Mishara’s record-breaking 120 gives Chitwan 204 against Kathmandu
results.content: The Sri Lankan batter struck an unbeaten century and shared a 154-run stand with captain Ravi Bopara as Chitwan Rhinos set Kathmandu Gorkhas a target of 205 in the NPL Eliminator.

results.title: Chitwan and Kathmandu look to go beyond the Eliminator in NPL
results.content: Kathmandu finished third and Chitwan fourth in the league stage, setting up a knockout clash for a place in the second qualifier of the Nepal Premier League.

results.title: Ex-minister Sumana Shrestha announces bid for Kathmandu mayor
results.content: The former RSP joint general secretary has yet to say whether she will contest as an independent or represent another political party.

results.title: Nepal urges China to reopen Tatopani border crossing
results.content: Foreign Minister Shisir Khanal tells a visiting Chinese delegation that the crossing is crucial to connectivity, as the Rasuwagadhi route remains shut following the August floods.

results.title: Second Mahadevtar tunnel bore breaks through Kathmandu-Tarai Expressway
results.content: The 3.445-km tunnel is one of two parallel bores at Mahadevtar. The Kathmandu-Tarai Expressway remains only about 50 percent complete after nine years of construction.

results.title: Kathmandu Valley begins selling meat with safety stamps
results.content: The government has deployed 240 trained inspectors to enforce meat inspection rules, with plans to make certification compulsory across the country by July 2027.

results.title: Kathmandu is going digital. Its birds and animals are paying the price
results.content: Telecom towers, data centres, floodlights and tangled fibre networks are disrupting the habitats and natural cycle of birds and animals. Yet the ecological consequences of this expanding infrastructure remain largely unstudied.

results.title: Kathmandu Gorkhas and Chitwan Rhinos target first Eliminator win
results.content: Having suffered exits in their previous playoff appearances, both franchises collide in a do-or-die battle to advance to Qualifier 2.

results.title: Why has Election Commission yet to update Nepali Congress leadership records?
results.content: The commission says it is still examining documents and constitutional amendments submitted by the party, but the delay has raised questions within the Congress amid a lingering dispute over its leadership.

results.title: Flood victims occupy Nepal Electricity Authority land, erect tents
results.content: More than 250 displaced families from Trishuli Bazar cleared the land using an excavator, accusing the government of delaying their rehabilitation.

results.title: At Nepal tax awards, finance minister raises low investment paradox
results.content: As the government honours top taxpayers for their fiscal contributions, businesses caution that structural bottlenecks, policy instability, and market risks continue to dampen long-term investment appetite.
